report.summary: Reviewed orchestrate.py chunk 1: claims about path inference, task preparation, and CLI behavior all kept; module-level imports uncheckable.
risks: line 27 | medium | Path(token).name for token like '..' or '.' yields '.' which is a dot, so relative paths like './foo' are recognized; but a bare '.' token from text like 'run .' would be treated as a path and resolved to repo root, silently adding the root as a task path; what would settle it: check whether '.' or '..' tokens are expected in messages and whether adding them as paths is intended

handoff.purpose: Prepare a user task by resolving paths, routing to an agent, recording memory, optionally enqueueing a Claude second opinion, and exposing a CLI.

symbols.name: _infer_paths
symbols.note: Parses path-like tokens from text, resolves relative to repo root, deduplicates, filters to existing files.

symbols.name: prepare_task
symbols.note: Resolves repo root, loads project, trims paths, routes task, collects status, appends memory event, optionally enqueues a Claude request, returns a result dict.

symbols.name: main
symbols.note: CLI entry point that parses arguments, calls prepare_task, and prints JSON.

claims.text: Prepare a user task for Codex/Claude collaboration.
claims.why: prepare_task routes the task to an agent and optionally enqueues a Claude second opinion, and the CLI exposes both paths.

claims.text: how the watcher may execute the queued task
claims.why: The help claims the lane affects how the watcher executes the queued task, but the watcher is not in this chunk; the lane is only passed to enqueue and its effect is external.
The source argument is passed into prepare_task and stored in the memory event's source field.

claims.text: single routes one task; spawn lets Ikarus decompose and fan out
claims.why: The strategy is passed to enqueue, but the decomposition/fan-out behavior is in another module; this chunk cannot observe it.

observations.what: Path inference treats any token containing a dot in its name as a path, including '.', '..', and '...' which resolve to the repo root or its parent and may be added as task paths.
_infer_paths silently ignores OSError on exists() and continues, so unreadable paths are dropped without warning.
The memory event summary is trimmed to 600 chars and todos to MAX_TODO_CHARS, so the CLI output may not reflect the full user message.
The chunk imports DEFAULT_POLICY and embeds it in both the memory payload and the result, but the policy content is external; no claim about it is made here.
